text_block_list.text:
The day of the NHK Mile Cup, where
Seeking the
Pearl also ran once, is here.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
From this point on, her path will diverge
from her
friends, who are all busy
preparing for the
Japanese Derby in the
Triple Crown tour.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, Эль Кондор Паса sheds no tears.
She
heads to the race in good spirits to
prove she is
capable of taking on the
world.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
